interaction_history.overview: A couple and their 12-year-old son move into a giant house for the summer. Things start acting strange almost immediately. It seems that every time some gets hurt on the grounds the beat-up house seems to repair itself.
interaction_history.title: Burnt Offerings

interaction_history.overview: In Mystery, Alaska, life revolves around the legendary Saturday hockey game at the local pond. But everything changes when the hometown team unexpectedly gets booked in an exhibition match against the New York Rangers. When quirky small-towners, slick promoters and millionaire athletes come together.
interaction_history.title: Mystery, Alaska

interaction_history.overview: Stark, perverse story of murder, kidnapping, and police corruption in Mexican border town.
interaction_history.title: Touch of Evil

interaction_history.overview: In the city of New York, comedian Alvy Singer falls in love with the ditsy Annie Hall.
interaction_history.title: Annie Hall

interaction_history.overview: In a dystopian future Australia, a vicious biker gang murders a cop's family, and makes his fight with them personal.
interaction_history.title: Mad Max

interaction_history.overview: A psychological thriller about an eight year old boy named Cole Sear who believes he can see into the world of the dead. A child psychologist named Malcolm Crowe comes to Cole to help him deal with his problem, learning that he really can see ghosts of dead people.
interaction_history.title: Sixth Sense, The

interaction_history.overview: After an encounter with UFOs, a line worker feels undeniably drawn to an isolated area in the wilderness where something spectacular is about to happen.
interaction_history.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind

interaction_history.overview: When CIA Analyst Jack Ryan interferes with an IRA assassination, a renegade faction targets Jack and his family as revenge.
interaction_history.title: Patriot Games

interaction_history.overview: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal and restore order to his world, before the grotesque race of Skeksis find and use the crystal for evil.
interaction_history.title: Dark Crystal, The

interaction_history.overview: Selfish yuppie Charlie Babbitt's father left a fortune to his savant brother Raymond and a pittance to Charlie; they travel cross-country.
interaction_history.title: Rain Man
